title: Claude Code Printed Your MCP Secrets
caption:
I put ${API_KEY} in .mcp.json so I would never have to look at the key again.

Claude Code 2.1.268, shipped September 10, fixed something I did not know was happening: claude mcp list, claude mcp get, /mcp and /plugin server details and MCP login errors were all showing the resolved value instead of the placeholder. Plugin and marketplace errors were printing tokens straight out of git source URLs too.

I have screen-shared that exact command on a call. Upgrading does not un-print it.

Rotating yours tonight?

slides.headline:
claude mcp list
Printed Your Secrets
slides.sub: Resolved ${VAR} values, shown in plain output. Fixed September 10 in 2.1.268.

slides.title: Placeholders, Not Secrets
slides.sub: Put ${API_KEY} in .mcp.json and the file holds no key. That is the documented pattern.

slides.title: Then It Resolved Them
slides.sub: The commands printed the expanded value, not the placeholder you wrote.

items: claude mcp list and claude mcp get
